steps.subject: sky
steps.action: warm crisscross glow in the upper sky
steps.load: a little crimson tapped into the bristles
steps.rule: the wet white lets the colors soften together

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blue sky over the crimson
steps.motion: crisscross strokes down to the crimson
steps.rule: crimson is weak, so no cleaning is needed

steps.subject: water
steps.action: lay in water with blue and phthalo green
steps.load: a touch of green added to the blue
steps.rule: leaves a glimmer of light across the water

steps.subject: water
steps.action: blend the water into the sky color
steps.rule: no visible line between the two colors

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tap a fluffy cloud with white
steps.rule: tapping gives soft fluffy edges

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: barely blend the cloud base
steps.rule: leaves the top edges but softens behind

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: small lavender floaters far back
steps.rule: suggests small things floating far away

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: big cloud over the floaters
steps.motion: sweep the cloud down over the floaters

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend the base of the big cloud
steps.motion: blend very lightly, lift and fluff
steps.rule: just enough to soften the base

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: lay in a dark mountain ridge
steps.load: dark blue-based mix from the roll
steps.motion: pull out flat and cut across
steps.rule: choose where peaks and valleys go first

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: soften the mountain base with 2in
steps.motion: pull down and blend the base
steps.rule: brush strokes lay out shapes without commitment

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: knife highlights on the peaks
steps.load: roll of white on the knife
steps.motion: let the knife bounce with no pressure
steps.rule: knife barely touches so the paint does not flatten

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: shadow areas under the highlights
steps.load: blue and white roll on the knife
steps.rule: every highlight needs its own shadow

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: soft mist at the base
steps.rule: creates the illusion of mist

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap distant tree tops in grey-brown

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: lay in a small baby mountain
steps.new: a small peak grows into a larger mountain

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: mist at the base of the baby mountain
steps.motion: tap a little mist at the base
steps.rule: big trees in front will push it back

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: tap far evergreens with the dark mix
steps.rule: too much detail loses the sense of distance

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pop in a few bushes with the 1in
steps.motion: pop in bushes in front of the evergreens

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: light the bushes with yellows and white
steps.load: white dipped in, then yellows and green
steps.rule: a mix of yellows gives varied greens

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: push upward for bush tufts

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: red tips on the bushes
steps.rule: red tips look like flowers

steps.subject: waterfall
steps.action: waterfall pushed in with thin white

steps.rule: thin paint slides over thick paint without mixing

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap downward background trees
steps.rule: vary the shapes so trees do not look copied

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: push a big bush upward

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: tap reflections downward with reversed brush
steps.rule: downward taps become reflections in the water

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull the reflections straight down
steps.rule: angled reflections would bother the eye

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: black and yellow green in the bushes
steps.load: black and yellow mixed on the brush
steps.motion: pull the brush in one direction
steps.rule: black and yellow make a deep green

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: lay in a stone for the bank
steps.rule: holds the greenery up so it does not fall in

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: grass accents along the bank
steps.rule: leaving dark underneath shows depth

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: pull a bit of bank color down
steps.motion: pull down with the small edge
steps.rule: makes the bank look thick, not stuck on

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: grass accents with liquid white only
steps.where: middle and right of the bank

steps.action: drop in a tree with limbs
